subject.title: fix(web-search): align credential presence with usable providers

question: Should the security audit intentionally execute documented light public-artifact modules from installed external plugin roots to evaluate provider-owned credential hooks?
rationale: The implementation is guarded and no concrete vulnerability was found, but accepting a new audit-time plugin code-loading boundary requires repository-owner intent rather than automated correctness judgment alone.

options.title: Accept the guarded light path
options.body: Allow installed external provider light artifacts during audit after the CI repair, preserving parity for custom configured credential fields.

options.title: Keep audit metadata-only
options.body: Reject external artifact execution and require a new manifest or SDK metadata contract describing configured credential fields without loading plugin code.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded light path
recommendation.body: Allow installed external provider light artifacts during audit after the CI repair, preserving parity for custom configured credential fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The current detector and generic provider credential-hook architecture trace to this owner’s merged work.
